subject: Dedicated capacity pricing qualification: GPU type, reserved capacity size, throughput targets
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: John Smith <john.smith@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-21T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Dedicated capacity pricing qualification: GPU type, reserved capacity size, throughput targets

Hi John — great to meet on the call this morning. Quick recap and next steps so we have alignment from the discovery: 

Summary of ask
- Primary workload: high-throughput text generation for customer support summarization and routing (mix of chat + long-form summaries)
- Model family: open Llama-family / 70B variants (low-latency preference); willing to test both 70B and 13B variants for cost/latency tradeoffs
- Monthly token volume (estimate): ~1.5B tokens/month (you mentioned up to ~2B in peak scenarios)
- Target unit economics: ideally <= $1,000 per 1M tokens (target mentioned ~$800-1,000/1M) — please confirm
- Budget range: $20k-80k/month for inference (initial committed budget range)
- Latency SLO: p95 generation latency <= 400ms for 2k context typical prompts (we should validate on specific prompt set)

Throughput and capacity sizing notes
- Peak concurrency: expect 100-150 concurrent sessions during peak hours
- Peak token throughput target (aggregate): ~3k-6k tokens/sec across the cluster depending on model variant and quantization
- Preferred GPU types discussed: H100 (better fp16 throughput/latency) vs A100 (cost-optimized) — you mentioned H100 preference for latency-sensitive paths

What I will send by EOD
- Initial sizing and cost ranges for Dedicated (reserved) capacity: GPU options (A100/H100), reserved GPU counts (2/4/8), expected aggregate throughput and cost-per-1M-tokens ranges
- Mutual action plan (timeline + procurement contacts) and a short usage estimate spreadsheet attached

Questions / asks for you
1) Can you confirm the monthly token high-water mark (is 2B a hard ceiling?)
2) Do you have a strict preference for H100 vs A100 for initial commit, or would you accept hybrid (H100 for low-latency, A100 for batch jobs)?
3) Procurement timeline and PO process (we'll include a simplified quote + SOW once sizing is agreed)

Next steps
- I'll send initial pricing ranges + recommended reserved configurations today.
- Schedule quote review + engineering sizing call (30m) — are you available tomorrow 10:00-11:00am PT?

Attachments: usage-estimates-20280721.xlsx, mutual-action-plan-20280721.docx

Thanks — talk soon.

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
From: John Smith <john.smith@finlytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, procurement@finlytics.com
Date: 2028-07-21T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity pricing qualification: GPU type, reserved capacity size, throughput targets

Thanks Marissa — great summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Monthly tokens: we should plan for 1.8B tokens/month as our working number (1.5B is baseline, 2B is the absolute ceiling for Q3)
- Model: primary target is Llama-70B quantized fp16 or 4-bit if perf/quality tradeoffs allow. We'll run 13B for cheaper routing, but most production will be 70B variants
- GPU preference: we prefer H100s for the low-latency cohort (p95 requirement) — we understand cost delta vs A100. Hybrid sounds acceptable (H100 for 50% of traffic, A100 for batch)
- Budget: we can stretch to $60k/month if unit economics align; target UD (unit-dollar) goal is $900 / 1M tokens ideally; absolute max budget for committed capacity is $75k/mo
- Throughput target: target aggregate sustained throughput ~4k tokens/sec with spikes to ~6k for limited windows

Procurement: looped in procurement; our timeline is to finalize a vendor and contract by mid-August. We'll need a formal quote and standard SOC2 + DPA terms.

Next: pls send the price bands and recommended reserved configs and we'll review internally. 10am PT tomorrow mostly works — confirming with the team and will reply with final availability.

—
John Smith
Sr. ML Engineer | FinLytics
john.smith@finlytics.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: John Smith <john.smith@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, procurement@finlytics.com
Date: 2028-07-21T13:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity pricing qualification: GPU type, reserved capacity size, throughput targets

Hi John — thanks for the confirmations. Attached is a quick initial pricing write-up (initial-pricing-20280721.pdf) and I captured the numbers below so you have them inline. These are ballpark ranges for committed (reserved) Dedicated capacity.

Assumptions used
- 1.8B tokens/month baseline workload (mix of 13B + 70B serving)
- Expected average tokens per request ~500; p95 latency target 400ms on H100 for 2k context
- Hybrid GPU plan assumed for pricing examples (50% H100, 50% A100) where noted

Recommended reserved configs & preliminary unit economics
1) Small: 2 x H100 reserved
  - Estimated sustained throughput: ~900-1,200 tok/s (good for dev + early-prod)
  - Estimated cost range (monthly, infra + infra-ops): $28k-36k
  - Implied $/1M tokens: ~$15.5-120.0 (note: we provide consumption-based billing overlays — see full PDF)

2) Medium: 4 x H100 reserved (recommended starting point for your 1.8B target)
  - Estimated sustained throughput: ~1,800-2,400 tok/s
  - Peak handling with autoscale/burst: up to ~5k tok/s for short windows
  - Estimated cost range (monthly): $48k-60k
  - Implied $/1M tokens: ~$26.5-33.5 (depends on model mix and cache hit rates)

3) Large: 8 x H100 reserved
  - Estimated sustained throughput: ~3,600-4,800 tok/s
  - Estimated cost range (monthly): $88k-110k
  - Implied $/1M tokens: ~$49-61

Notes on unit economics: these $/1M numbers are rough and reflect raw infra + reserved cost amortization. Optimizations (quantization, KV prefix caching, batching) and model choice can materially reduce the effective $/1M tokens — we typically see 20-40% savings with workload tuning.

Hybrid option (H100 + A100 pool)
- If you want to use H100s for latency-sensitive routes and A100s for bulk/background jobs, we can present blended pricing that brings Medium cost down ~10-15% while keeping p95 latency for the primary cohort.

Next steps
- I can get a formal Dedicated quote (line-item for reserved GPUs, estimated throughput, SLA, onboarding hours) ready by EOD tomorrow.
- Let's lock a 30m call to walk the numbers and finalize preferred config — would 10am PT tomorrow work?
- Please confirm procurement contact for the formal quote (I see procurement@finlytics.com in cc) and any PO/T&Cs checklist we should include.

Attachments: initial-pricing-20280721.pdf

Best,
Marissa
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-21T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity pricing qualification: GPU type, reserved capacity size, throughput targets [Internal]

Marcus — moving this to you for a formal quote. FinLytics is targeting 1.8B tokens/mo, prefers H100 for low-latency traffic, hybrid acceptable. Budget up to $75k/mo committed; target $900/1M tokens.

Suggested immediate actions:
- Please prepare a formal quote for the 4xH100 reserved config and a blended hybrid (2xH100 + 4xA100) option with line-item infra, onboarding, and optional premium SLA add-on; include estimated throughput and expected $/1M tokens for each.
- Include a note on expected latency p95 for 2k context on H100 (we should call out measured p95 from our internal 70B perf runs)
- Recommend a discount band (we typically tier at 10-20% for 12mo commitments at this ARR) — propose starting discount at 12% for 12mo commitment in the quote

Procurement timeline: mid-August close. Need the quote by EOD tomorrow to meet their evaluation window.

Thanks — looped Marcus since he'll finalize the line items.

—
Marissa
